cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Helpful Culprit
cards.instruction: Hide that the problem is your fault while enthusiastically helping investigate it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't sweep yet. We establish how the vase broke before we disturb the pieces.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why have you got glue on your fingers?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We identify the adhesive before drawing conclusions. Bring me the tube, by the cap, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's a piece of the vase stuck to your thumb.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then stop pulling at my hand. Photograph the fragment where it is; I appear to be the only person preserving the evidence.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 evidence preservation and A3 adhesive identification help A deflect the incriminating B2 clue.

responseLogic.evidence: B4 shard supports photography but A5 suddenly says B is pulling A hand without that action being established.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 plausibly point out evidence against the self-appointed investigator.

heightening.evidence: A5 preservation reversal follows the shard but adds an unsupported physical intervention.
